name: Gauge
description: A gauge face: a scale of ticks with one needle laid across it.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 6%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-conic-gradient(from 0deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 4deg, transparent 4deg 30deg); mask: repeating-conic-gradient(from 0deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 4deg, transparent 4deg 30deg); border-radius: 50%; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 48%; top: 12%; width: 4%; height: 40%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); transform-origin: 50% 100%; -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 45deg, 90deg, 135deg, 180deg, 225deg, 270deg, 315deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 45deg, 90deg, 135deg, 180deg, 225deg, 270deg, 315deg)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
